name: Kali Pentest MCP Server
description: Provides secure access to Kali Linux penetration testing tools including nmap, nikto, dirb, wpscan, and sqlmap for educational vulnerability assessment on whitelisted targets. Runs in a controlled Docker environment and includes reconnaissance capabilities for authorized security testing.
